seed: The starter Button the way the variants mock draws it (ui-variants.html, the .pmatrix cells and the Properties group): Primary, Secondary or Ghost, Small, Medium or Large, with a leading icon a copy can hide and swap. This walk drops a Button at Next defaults and reads its panel (Variant, Size, Show icon with its On word, the Label box with the T glyph, Icon), makes it Large with the pointer and reads its height, undoes that in one step, walks it through Secondary and Ghost, turns its icon off and reads the row closing up, picks Wand from the Icon menu with a click, carries the Wand across to Large, picks No icon, and opens Edit Original to photograph the nine looks in their grid.

steps.reads: Variant, already on Primary, tooltip none
Size, already on Medium, tooltip none

steps.note: a Button copy at Next defaults: a blue capsule with the sparkle and Button, 32 tall. Panel: VARIANT Primary | Secondary | Ghost with Primary lit, SIZE Small | Medium | Large with Medium lit, then Instance properties: Show icon switch with On beside it, the Label box with the T glyph, Icon reading Sparkle

steps.reads: Size, already on Large, tooltip none

steps.note: Large clicked: the copy is 40 tall with more room either side and bigger words

steps.reads: Size, already on Medium, tooltip none
Variant, already on Secondary, tooltip none

steps.note: Secondary: a white capsule with a hairline round it and dark words

steps.reads: Variant, already on Ghost, tooltip none

steps.note: Ghost: nothing behind the grey words and icon
Show icon turned off with a click: the switch says Off and the capsule closes up round the word
Wand picked from the Icon menu with a click: the copy leads with the wand
made Large after picking Wand: the Large look still leads with the wand
No icon picked from the same menu: the icon goes and the Show icon switch reads Off, because they are one fact
Edit Original: the nine looks in a grid, Primary, Secondary and Ghost down the side and Small, Medium and Large along the top
